# Test corpus

Generated by `scripts/make-pki.sh` then `scripts/make-fixtures.sh` with
c2patool 0.27.21 (c2pa-rs 0.90.21). Everything here is signed with the
**TEST ONLY** PKI in `pki/`, which no real validator trusts.

Each image `X` has two oracle files written by `scripts/oracle`, never edited by hand:

- `X.expected.json`: `c2patool X --detailed` with default trust. The test PKI
  is untrusted, so signed files show `signingCredential.untrusted`.
- `X.trusted.expected.json`: the same with `pki/trust-anchors.pem` trusted.

If c2patool fails, the file holds `{"c2patool_error": "...", "exit_code": N}`.
Load fixtures from Go with `internal/fixtures`.

## unsigned/

Generated by `scripts/genimages` (deterministic). Expected: c2patool `No claim found`.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `small.jpg` | 64×48 gradient, no APPn segments |
| `exif.jpg` | `small.jpg` with a minimal APP1 Exif segment |
| `large.jpg` | 480×360 noise; its thumbnail makes the signed manifest span several APP11 segments |
| `small.png` | 64×48 gradient |
| `large.png` | 256×192 noise |

## signed/

All ES256, claim v2, `c2pa.hash.data` hard binding, auto thumbnail.
Expected state: `Valid` (untrusted) / `Trusted` (with anchors).

| File | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `small.jpg` | `small.jpg` | `c2pa.created`, digitalCapture; 1 APP11 segment |
| `exif.jpg` | `exif.jpg` | c2patool puts APP11 **before** the APP1 Exif segment |
| `large.jpg` | `large.jpg` | 7 APP11 segments |
| `titled-ts.jpg` | `small.jpg` | `dc:title`, `stds.schema-org.CreativeWork`, RFC 3161 timestamp (DigiCert); `timeStamp.untrusted` is informational |
| `edited.jpg` | `signed/small.jpg` as parent | 2 manifests; parent ingredient, `c2pa.opened` + `c2pa.color_adjustments` |
| `small.png` | `small.png` | `caBX` chunk |
| `large.png` | `large.png` | `caBX` chunk |
| `ts.png` | `small.png` | RFC 3161 timestamp |

## broken/

One defect each, made from `signed/small.*` by `scripts/mkbroken` (except `expired.jpg`).

| File | Defect | Oracle result |
|---|---|---|
| `data-flip.jpg` | 1 bit flipped in JPEG scan data | `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `data-flip.png` | 1 bit flipped in IDAT, CRC fixed | `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `sig-flip.jpg` | last byte of the COSE signature flipped | `claimSignature.mismatch` |
| `assertion-flip.jpg` | `c2pa.created` → `c2pa.createD` in the actions assertion | `assertion.hashedURI.mismatch`, `assertion.action.malformed` |
| `truncated-app11.jpg` | file cut halfway through the APP11 segment | c2patool error: could not parse JPEG |
| `bad-jumbf-length.jpg` | `c2pa.assertions` superbox LBox set to 0x7FFFFFF0 | c2patool error: claim superbox not found |
| `expired.jpg` | signed by a 90-second leaf cert that has since expired, no timestamp | `signingCredential.expired` |

## samples/

Put public C2PA sample files here (`.jpg`/`.png`) and rerun
`go run ./scripts/oracle testdata` to add their oracle output.
